summary: The trade ran strongly favorable (+45 to +65pts) for the first ~7 minutes, then whipsawed hard: it round-tripped the entire favorable excursion in about 3 minutes, going from +45 to -3.75 to -11.25, with HA-against and PROPP-against firing repeatedly and ER10 collapsing to 0.12 (trend efficiency gone). I held through the first negative print since it was only marginally red, but bailed once the second consecutive frame confirmed continued deterioration rather than a bounce -- a full giveback of a large favorable move plus continuing adverse drift is a stronger wrong-direction signature than a normal dip. Next time I'd watch the speed/magnitude of the round-trip (a >100% giveback of peak favorable excursion within a few minutes) as an earlier bail trigger rather than waiting for a second confirming red frame.
